title: Composition-to-ARI Derivative Registration
objective: Allow an authored panel, pose or composite render to become a new ARI derivative with exact source references, renderer/compositor version and rights lineage while preserving ARI as asset/provenance authority.
acceptance: Derivative-registration requests preserve stable source SAA project/page/panel, pose or composite identity and enumerate the governed source resources used.
Renderer/compositor identity and version are explicit registration inputs rather than inferred metadata.
ARI derivative provenance preserves exact source-resource references and parent lineage without copying or rewriting source-domain truth.
Rights/capability lineage is explicit and missing, stale, denied or incompatible source rights fail closed without fabricated permission.
Successful handoff registers through ARI authority rather than creating a parallel SAA asset library or replacement provenance record.
Provider-off local preparation remains supported; optional AI and paid cloud are not required for derivative-registration metadata.
SAA-15 and later export/share/publication/SMB10B behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-14 owns the SAA-to-ARI derivative-registration handoff only; ARI retains derivative asset identity, provenance, rights and lifecycle authority.
Registration may reference rendered derivative bytes but may not mutate source ARI resources, Character/Scene/narrative truth or historical SAA versions.
No parallel asset library, rights fabrication, automatic semantic rewriting, export/share/publication or final Creator integration authority is granted.
SAA-15 remains blocked until verified SAA-14 closeout.
next_action: Establish causal RED for exact SAA source identity, renderer/compositor metadata, governed source-resource provenance and fail-closed rights lineage; then implement only SAA-14.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner authorized continuing to SAA-14 after verified SAA-13 closeout.
